name: yield-xyz-agentkit-circle
description: The Circle connector — sign and broadcast Yield.xyz transactions via Circle agent wallets. Requires the yield-xyz-agentkit plugin — install it too.

interface.shortDescription: The Circle connector — sign and broadcast yields via Circle agent wallets.
interface.longDescription: Connects the Yield.xyz AgentKit to Circle agent wallets: wallet creation, spending policy, calldata-to-ABI decoding, signing, and broadcasting via the Circle CLI. Install alongside the Yield.xyz AgentKit plugin.
defaultPrompt: Set up a Circle agent wallet for autonomous yield.
Deposit 200 USDC into Aave V3 via my Circle wallet.
Set a daily spending limit on my Circle agent wallet.
